content: Define a worker-injectable cdev registered-memory import seam that turns a daemon-owned object-table range into a backend memory handle with an explicit retain/release reference, then prove the CPU backend Add/Copy path without changing mf_backend_api_v1 or the Linux UAPI.

Committed cdev resolver-side CdevBackendMemoryImporter and exercised it with the real CPU backend host-memory import for two COPY ranges. The resolver returned complete references; the worker retained and released both through the existing copy path. Focused cdev/component tests passed 2/2, full development CTest passed 84/84, and git diff --check passed. Content revision c40c0e3 records Agent Harness (codex) as Author and Committer.
